summary_1line: Manthara manipulates Queen Kaikeyi, arguing Rama’s coronation will endanger Bharata and urging Rama’s exile so Bharata can rule.

image_candidates.scene_text: Manthara angrily throws the jeweled ornament to the floor while rebuking Queen Kaikeyi in the royal chamber.
The beautiful Queen Kaikeyi sits on her couch while the hunchback Manthara leans forward whispering urgent warnings about Rama’s coronation.
Manthara points dramatically as she warns that Rama will banish or kill Bharata if he becomes king.
